name: vLLM PR 52555: Add opt-in custom all-reduce max-size override
notes: Authoritative statement of the custom-all-reduce eligibility rule: at TP=2 custom all-reduce can operate over PCIe when functional GPU P2P exists and NVLink is not required; at TP>2 the constructor requires full one-hop NVLink and otherwise disables custom all-reduce entirely.
